stem: In the $holoprosencephaly$ spectrum, which finding represents the most subtle "microform" of the condition?
explanation: This represents the mildest end of the spectrum, where an individual may appear otherwise normal but carry the genetic risk.
rationale: Look for a dental anomaly that can occur in individuals with otherwise normal facial features.

optionExplanations.A: This is the most severe presentation of the spectrum, involving a single central eye.
optionExplanations.B: This is a severe malformation involving a proboscis and very closely set eyes.
optionExplanations.C: While less severe than cyclopia, this is a significant facial malformation that is not the most subtle form.
optionExplanations.D: This represents the mildest end of the spectrum, where an individual may appear otherwise normal but carry the genetic risk.

source.hint: Look for a dental anomaly that can occur in individuals with otherwise normal facial features.
